recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the Security WG wants to change the broader policy about when display text is useful in audit logs; FHIR-8790 itself is already applied.
issue_request: FHIR-8790 was a Published Security WG change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for AuditEvent notes guidance that coded values do not need their displayName populated when the code is sufficient and omitting display text helps keep large audit logs small.
initial_application: Git-svn commit bc340a2b5e2ea88134bec7cf3609a7f62deb5c3f added the requested sentence to source/auditevent/auditevent-notes.xml. Later edits retained the note and refined the wording from displayName to FHIR's code display element.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists auditevent=AuditEvent, so the AuditEvent source folder is in current build scope. Current source/auditevent/auditevent-notes.xml states that the code display element can be left off to keep AuditEvent small and minimize the impact of a large audit log of similar entries. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current active source already satisfies the issue in current FHIR terminology.
